input.decision: Stage: results and invoice, with part of the job still open (PM-DOC-001). The landlord approved attendance on all four reported issues (event 004). Copper Finch Plumbing attended on 12/09 (events 020 and 021). Their invoice (event 022, tap-works-invoice.pdf) covers only the two taps. It shows a different property address and no amount. The case cannot close: the vent water ingress and bedroom damp are a possible hazard with no findings recorded, the invoice is defective, and the landlord's insurance and roof-leak history requests from event 004 are still undone (PM-CLOSE-001). What happens next, in order: (1) I emailed Gareth for his findings on the vent and damp, a quote if remedial work or another trade is needed (no work without approval), and a reissued invoice with the correct address and itemised amounts with VAT. (2) I emailed the landlord: taps done per invoice, invoice being corrected, vent and damp findings awaited. I also told him honestly that the insurance and history checks are not yet done, and asked who insures the building. (3) I emailed the tenant asking her to confirm the taps are fixed, tell us whether the damp has spread or mould has appeared, and avoid using any electric fan in the vent if water reaches it. (4) The insurance and history review goes to a human, as no tool covers it. (5) The case is on hold, Waiting for Provider, with a chase on 17/09. Any quote goes to the landlord for approval (PM-AUTH-002). I did not send a second contractor (PM-AUTH-005).
